Full Breakdown of Artist Paydays Revealed! Continue » Justin Bieber is one of the headliners at the 2026 Coachella Music Festival this year and he’s going to be earning a lot of money for his two performances across the next two weekends. The singer is performing the Saturday headline slot on April 11 and April 18. Rolling Stone reports that Justin is getting “north of $10 million for the two weekends — $5 million per weekend.” “It’s a groundbreaking move for a headliner, and it’s something he built entirely on his own,” a source told Rolling Stone. “Between headlining Coachella and the success of Swag, it’s clear this is the start of an exciting new era for Justin — one where he’s fully in the driver’s seat.” All of the different acts at Coachella are paid different amounts and paydays have varied over the years. We’ve gathered all of the data that we could find!
